document.title: WORLD MONITOR INTEGRATION — HOPEFX AI Trading
document.description: Complete integration map of the World Monitor geopolitical intelligence system within the HOPEFX AI Trading framework. This is the machine-readable companion to docs/WORLD_MONITOR_INTEGRATION.md.

world_monitor.description: Real-time geopolitical intelligence platform covering conflicts, sanctions, country intel, outages, satellite data, and news.
world_monitor.gold_relevance: Gold (XAU/USD) is a safe-haven asset — it rises during geopolitical crises, sanctions, conflicts, and currency instability.

rest_api.registration_note: The router is registered lazily at startup via ComponentRegistry, not directly in app.py. ComponentRegistry calls app.include_router(r) after create_news_router() returns.

rest_endpoints.description: Gold trading signal derived from live geopolitical intelligence
rest_endpoints.notes: direction is always returned in uppercase: BUY, SELL, or HOLD

rest_endpoints.description: Current geopolitical events list with severity and gold impact
Full risk assessment: global score, outlook, regions, country risks, recommendations
Curated World Monitor dashboard deep-links for XAU/USD trading
Upcoming high-impact economic events within N hours
Market sentiment score for a trading symbol (-1.0 bearish to +1.0 bullish)

data_layers.conflicts: Active military conflicts and war zones
data_layers.country_intel: Country-level political risk and instability scores

SANCTIONS.description: Sanctions disrupt supply chains, increase uncertainty

NATURAL_DISASTER.description: Major disasters can trigger risk-off moves

CYBER_ATTACK.description: State-level cyber attacks increase geopolitical tension

ECONOMIC_CRISIS.description: Currency/debt crises are strongest gold drivers

flow.action: Fetch live events from World Monitor API or built-in risk model
Classify each event's gold impact (BULLISH / BEARISH / NEUTRAL)
Aggregate individual event scores into a global risk score (0-100)
Map global risk to gold outlook (STRONGLY_BULLISH through STRONGLY_BEARISH)
Emit BUY / SELL / HOLD signal with confidence and reasoning
Serve signal to dashboard, strategy engine, and AI bot
Incorporate geopolitical signal as one factor in consensus signal generation

news/__init__.py.notes: Hosts create_news_router() factory and the module-level _risk_provider singleton

core/startup_factories.py.notes: Calls create_news_router() and registers the router with the FastAPI app via ComponentRegistry

env_vars.name: WORLD_MONITOR_API_KEY
env_vars.description: API key if required by self-hosted instance

env_vars.name: NEWS_API_KEY
env_vars.description: NewsAPI.org API key for news providers

env_vars.name: ALPHA_VANTAGE_KEY
env_vars.description: Alpha Vantage key for news + market data

configuration.startup_behaviour: All env vars are optional. The app starts without any of them; the news router is registered with required=False so a missing config does not block startup.
